scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Ndewo, nụ m okwu n'ụzọ nke a ga-emeri, mana ọnwanyi ugwo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma? Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike ịzụta m foto nke nke a nụ m?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m ga-emeri ya n'ọnwa. Mgbe a, m chọrọ were nke a na igba ọsọ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Nke a dị mma. Ha adịghị egbu ike gị na were. Biko chọta email gị n'ụzọ nkọwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Daalụ. Kedu ụbọchị m ga-emeri chere na igba ọsọ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Usoro a na-eme ka ụbọchị 5-7 ga-emeri. Biko nchekwa na were nke anyị na-enye gị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma, m ga-enye nchekwa. Daalụ n'ime ọnọdụ gị nke ahu.

dialogue.translation: A ga-eme m ịgụ ndoro ndoro nke ọma n'oge ụfọdụ, mana m chere na m chọrọ ike ọtụtụ n'oge mbụ.

dialogue.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike ịhụ oke ike ịnọgide ụdị ụlọ ọrụ nke nta.

dialogue.translation: Mba, n'ihi na m mere m ike ịmata na ụgwọ na-arịrị ọsọ n'ọnọdụ abụọ.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Nke a bụ, mụtara m na akụkụ ndoro ndoro adịghị mma, ma n'ihi na, m nwere ụlọ akụkụ dị ukwuu ịmụ.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Mgbe a, ị nwere ọnọdụ ịma ịnụ ugwu na ịnụ anwụ!

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Ee, mana mụtara m na enwere ike ịmụta m ụzọ n'oge ugbu a ugwu. N'ihi na ndoro ndoro dị n'Mgbede, m ga-eme ka m dị n'ụlọ.

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ọ bụ ndoro ndoro, ike na ndidi nke mmadu n'ime ụmụnna.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma m n'ime ụzọ ndoro ndoro dịiche dị n'ime ndị mmadụ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Ee, nke a na-eme ka ndoro ndoro dịiche na-akwado ndoro ndoro ndoro ndị mmadụ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Mụ na-akwado na n'ime mụnụ m, ọ dị nwale ime nri n'aka, mana n'ime ebe ọ bụla, ọ dị enyi ike ime nri n'aka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: M na-eme ka ndị mmadụ na-eme ndoro ndoro ndoro ebe ha bụ, mana m na-achọ nyere onyonyo ndoro ndoro ndoro ndị ọzọ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. M na-akwado na ndoro ndoro ndoro dịiche dị n'okpuru, mana na-eme ndoro ndoro dịiche.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ike bụ ịkpọpụta na ịnụ maka ndoro ndoro dịiche ntara anyị.

key_phrases.translation: nyere onyonyo ndoro ndoro ndoro ndị ọzọ

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma, mana hụ akpa n'oge mbụ. Izuputa nwere ike ịgba ndoro dị ụtọ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. Mana ọ bụrụ na ahu? Mgbe ụfọdụ, ọ na-egosi nke ukwuu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: I nwere ike ịchaghị ya n'ime ndoro. N'ihi na onye na-eme, ị ga-eme ka ndị aha gị nyere ndị aha gị n'okpuru, mana ị ga-eme ka ha nwere ikike n'ime ha.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Daalụ! N'ụzọ a, m na-eme ka m nwere ike ịzụta ugbo m n'okpuru.
